name: ante-obsidian
description: Obsidian desktop plugin for Ante-powered terminal Markdown workflows with diff previews and Chat with Ante.

scripts.build: npm run sync-version && npm run build -w @antigma/ante-sdk && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build:release: npm run build && npm run release:package
scripts.dev: npm run sync-version && npm run build -w @antigma/ante-sdk && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.release:prepare: npm run build && npm run release:package && npm run release:context
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @antigma/ante-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @antigma/ante-sdk && npm run typecheck -w ante-obsidian-plugin
